QuestInfo.name: [10th Anniversary] Dedicated Researcher
QuestInfo.0: You now know all the secrets of monsters! Talk to #b#p9000292##k about rewards.

0.0: You've done so much to help me uncover the secrets of all these monsters. I can't thank you enough for your help!
0.1: I'll give you a whole mess of gifts, just like I promised. Make sure they all get to your Inventory safely.

yes.0: Give me a moment... I need some time to get everything together. Talk to me in a little bit.

no.0: Huh? Why would you refuse a gift?

yes.0: Enjoy! You earned every bit of that. Feel free to come back and visit anytime! I'll always have time for you... if I'm not on a speaking tour or doing book signings.
